reviews.review:
After just finishing Piotr Bunkowski's high school project from 2017 A trip to Yugolavia i wondered if he pursued a career in game development. His first effort was a succes in my eyes and i found out he and his colleague started developing a new FMV game called Purgatorium: A Family Torn Apart. Unfortunately it was cancelled, the reason was "creative differences". They did release a demo on itch.io. 

This is a little backstory so you might understand the game a bit better.
Now onto the gameplay, it's pretty limited, movement is only horizontal and mouse clicks are for firing.
A simple heal system, 2 guns? and a front kick to back off enemies is all that is at your disposal. The story makes the game and i'm happy he chose this topic.

The good: 

+ Great enemy and weapon design.
+ FMV mixed in between the levels to tell a story.
+ Behind the scenes is always nice to see in the extras.

The not so good

- Game is abit short
- Gameplay could have been a bit more exciting.

In the end i do recommend it.
